"LangChain is a framework designed to help developers build applications powered by large language models. Think of it as the glue that connects LLMs with other tools, data sources, and systems. Whether you're building a chatbot, a document analyzer, or an AI agent, LangChain provides the building blocks you need."
Key Features:
Chain together LLM calls and tools
Modular components that work together seamlessly
Production-ready with built-in observability
Model interoperability - switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more
